backfill_trigger_strategy: under nonblocking exclusive maintenance lock, verify exact trigger/function, disable only reject_mutation, update phase columns by exact gamePk, re-enable before commit; any error rolls back trigger state and data

cleanroom_append_only_trigger.definition: CREATE TRIGGER reject_mutation BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON mlb_cleanroom_v1.games FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION mlb_cleanroom_v1.reject_mutation()
cleanroom_append_only_trigger.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mlb_cleanroom_v1.reject_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'mlb_cleanroom_v1 source tables are append-only';
END $function$
